scope: acyclic normal C/N/O with terminal H/D
single saturated C5 or C6 ring
isolated simple C, N+ or Cl- observations
hydrogen_boundary: NumHydrogens and simple atom-label H refer to non-node attached H; they are not added together or to explicit H/D nodes. Missing NumHydrogens is not zero. No omitted-field valence inference.
selection_boundary: FormulaHTML is interpreted only for one exactly bound neutral carbon, Objects=1, Atoms=1, Bonds=0; the cut-bond suffix equals actual incident bond orders and UsedValences.
comparison_boundary: Expected chemistry is accepted only by compare_document, after observations are complete.
legacy_policy: 0.4 observations remain historical. No automatic upgrade, fallback or renamed qualification. A controller replay rejection stops before a new private run.
